why vynex

Kenya's trusted team for websites, apps & software

Ranked among Kenya's best

Businesses across Kenya choose VYNEX as one of the country's leading website, mobile app and software developers, and our work is the reason they come back and refer others.

10+ years of experience

A decade of building websites, Android and iOS apps and business systems means we have solved your problem before, and we know the pitfalls to avoid.

Honest, affordable pricing

Fair, upfront quotes with no hidden costs. You get premium quality at a price that suits small businesses and growing companies alike.

Quality you can see

Clean design, clean code and testing before every delivery. Fast on mobile data, secure by design and built to impress your customers.
